title: The Road
author: Cormac McCarthy
description: A father and his young son walk south through a burned, dead America, carrying what little they have and trying to stay good.
reasons: want a post-apocalyptic novel stripped down to a father and a son
like spare, bleak prose where every sentence earns its place
want to feel what protecting someone costs
can handle a book that is beautiful and very dark
dislikes: It is relentlessly grim, with almost no relief
The missing punctuation and repeated exchanges will annoy some readers
